name: Back Extension
steps: Anchor your ankles securely in a hyperextension bench with the top edge of the pad resting just below your hip creases.
Cross your arms over your chest or rest your fingertips behind your ears with your spine neutral.
Hinge smoothly forward at your hips to lower your torso down toward the floor while keeping your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back to raise your torso back until it forms a straight line with your legs.
tips: Keep your ribs down at the top so you stop in a straight line without hyperextending your lower back.
Adjust the pad slightly below your hip bones so your pelvis can hinge freely.
